# vendor/hikvision

Place the officially downloaded Linux device-network SDK here (operator step, see `docs/hikvision-sdk-installation.md`).

    sdk/linux-x86_64/   sdk/linux-aarch64/   include/   docs/   manifest.json (copy of manifest.example.json)

Everything except `.gitkeep`, this README and `manifest.example.json` is git-ignored. Mount read-only into containers.
Official sources: RTSP doc `https://knowbot.hikvision.com/webchatbot-pc/#/sharingPath?params=369049&sysNum=1693447044565&flowItemId=5075&type=0`,
SDK page `https://open.hikvision.com/download/5cda567cf47ae80dd41a54b3?type=10` (page links, not API endpoints).
